description: This file manages tool aliasing, grouping, and filtering logic for different modes in a system, including handling of allowed tools, alias resolution, mode-specific customization, and filtering based on feature flags and settings.

methods.name: getOrCreateRenamedTool
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached renamed version of a tool with a different alias name.

methods.name: resolveToolAlias
methods.description: Resolves an alias tool name to its canonical name.

methods.name: applyToolAliases
methods.description: Resolves all tools in a set from aliases to canonical names.

methods.name: getToolAliasGroup
methods.description: Returns all tool names in the same alias group as the given tool.

methods.name: applyModelToolCustomization
methods.description: Adjusts allowed tools based on model-specific inclusion/exclusion and alias renaming.

methods.name: filterNativeToolsForMode
methods.description: Filters native tools based on mode, feature flags, and model settings.

methods.name: hasAnyMcpResources
methods.description: Checks if any MCP server has resources available.

methods.name: isToolAllowedInMode
methods.description: Determines if a specific tool is permitted in the current mode considering settings and feature flags.

methods.name: getAvailableToolsInGroup
methods.description: Retrieves tools from a specific group that are allowed in the current mode.

methods.name: filterMcpToolsForMode
methods.description: Filters MCP tools based on whether use_mcp_tool is enabled in the current mode.
